verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own docs describe in-product AI that works over the user's mail data. Ask AI answers natural-language questions about the inbox and supports follow-up questions. Auto Labels classify incoming mail to show what's important, and Auto Drafts suggest replies using context from the inbox, calendar and web, with follow-up reminders. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of AI quality (all evidence is vendor claims), and in-app proactive insight summaries (thread summarization is documented only through external assistants via MCP).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: You can now get rapid answers without having to remember senders, guess keywords, or comb through messages.
You can ask follow-up questions in a conversation.
Emails are labeled the moment they arrive, so you can see what's important and what's not.
Auto Drafts now gather context from your inbox, your calendar, and the web. They can use information from other emails, insert availability, and conduct research online.
If your email needs a response, you’re automatically reminded to follow up—with a draft already written and ready to send.
